newsitem.title: GREECE: Dane Sea Lines to issue bonus shares.
newsitem.headline: Dane Sea Lines to issue bonus shares.

text.p: Greece's Dane Sea Lines said its fiscal 1996 pre-provision profit rose 63 percent to 1.06 billion drachmas from 648 million a year earlier.
The Rhodes-based company will propose a bonus share distribution to its upcoming annual shareholders meeting in June after capitalising reserves, its board said in a statement.
The plan is to issue four bonus shares for every 10 outstanding for shareholders on record on the day of its general assembly.
Dane shareholders will also be entitled to a 25 percent discount when using its ships on the Piraeus-Rhodes route, effective April 15.
The discount on tickets will be reduced to 15 percent during the high tourist season June 15 to September 15.
Dane experienced a significant rise in traffic during the first quarter of 1997. Passenger traffic rose 41 percent with cars up 26 percent and lorries 38 percent, it said.
First quarter revenues were up 17.8 percent compared to the same period a year earlier.
Dane shares closed up five drachmas at 782 on Tuesday. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
